Curriculum vitae

Dr. Piero Dolara was born in Florence Italy on march 13th 1944.

Dr. Piero Dolara was born in Florence Italy on March 13th 1944.
-In 1968 he obtained a degree in Medicine at the University of Florence, maxima cum laude, with a dissertation on monoaminoxidase and human arterial hypertension.

-In 1971 he was Assistant Professor of Pharmacology at the University of Florence, Department of Pharmacology.

-In 1977-78, as a Fogarty Fellow, he worked as a toxicologist on food research at Washington University in St. Louis, U.S.A.
-In 1980 he was visiting scientist at the National Cancer Institute, Bethesda Md.

-In 1981-2 he was in sabbatical at the Department of Environmental Toxicology, Madison, WI, U.S.A.
-In 1983 he was Associate Professor of Pharmacology at the University of Florence.

-In 1986 he received tenure as Full Professor of Pharmacology and Toxicology at the University of Florence, position held up to present.

Prof. Dolara is an adviser for environmental and toxicological problems of the Region of Tuscany and of the Italian Ministry of the Environment. He has been a consultant for WHO (on PAH pollution) and for the EEC (Bureau of Reference and Food-Agriculture Research).
